purpose: Record externally observed modeling practices worth evaluating without changing frozen production governance or creating Model_P authority.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Evaluate separately optimized probability/distribution models for moneyline, margin/spread, and totals rather than assuming one shared specification is optimal for every market.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: SportsEdge has coherent shared-distribution runtimes, but repeated NFL failures suggest dedicated target diagnostics may reveal where the shared M2 specification is structurally weak.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Research-only ablation comparing shared-distribution output against independently trained target models on development/validation windows only; final untouched holdouts remain sealed.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Compare Platt, isotonic, and temperature calibration using nested temporal validation rather than hard-coding a single calibrator family.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: SportsEdge enforces calibration gates strongly, but calibrator-family selection is not consistently exposed as a preregistered research dimension across all three sports.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Select calibrator only inside development/validation data and lock it before final holdout.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Require family-level ablations for Elo/ratings, rolling efficiency, rest/travel, injuries, weather, lineup/starter, and market-context inputs.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: SportsEdge has strong source and PIT governance but does not uniformly require a published marginal-value table showing which feature families help or hurt OOS calibration and log loss.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Produce research-only ablation artifacts with no promotion authority.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Add explicit distribution-drift diagnostics such as PSI/feature-shift alerts and prediction-distribution drift before serving.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: Current governance emphasizes provenance, PIT, calibration, CLV, and replay integrity more than systematic covariate-shift monitoring.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Shadow-only drift report; no automatic parameter or threshold changes.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Test structurally different model families and blend only when nested OOS evidence shows independent error reduction.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: Current candidate work has largely iterated within closely related model families; structurally diverse errors may be more useful than repeated local variants.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Pre-register candidate families and blending rule before final holdout; prohibit market-derived model probabilities from entering the ensemble.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Persist predictive interval width, ensemble disagreement, and book-line dispersion as diagnostics distinct from directional confidence.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: SportsEdge tracks edge and context well, but model epistemic disagreement is not yet a uniform first-class research artifact.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Use disagreement only as a blocker/diagnostic until validated; never as an unearned confidence boost.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Use one canonical deduplicated pitch/game warehouse for all MLB model families with a single feature-availability contract.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: SportsEdge has multiple MLB surfaces and strong replay policy, but a single materialized canonical research table could reduce cross-model feature-window divergence.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Design canonical PIT table and hash manifest before changing any production model.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Benchmark Negative Binomial or other overdispersed run-count models against Poisson for run distributions.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: A Poisson-like assumption can understate tail variance; public MLB work reports better run-distribution likelihood from overdispersed count models.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Compare temporal OOS log likelihood, calibration, and market-level probability accuracy with no production substitution.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Expand preregistered play-level efficiency features using rolling EPA/CPOE and opponent-adjusted splits from nflverse-style data.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: Repeated NFL game-level candidate failures indicate the current structural representation may be too coarse or miss stable play-level efficiency signal.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Use development seasons only for feature construction/search under the frozen NFL attempt budget; keep final holdout sealed.

observed_practices_to_evaluate.idea: Separate opener, current, and close as distinct market-context features/benchmarks, with provider-level dispersion and movement decomposition.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.sportsedge_gap: SportsEdge already tracks line movement and forward CLV, but this decomposition is not uniformly represented as a model-research artifact across football lanes.
observed_practices_to_evaluate.safe_next_test: Research-only context model; market information may benchmark or condition a separate market-aware model but may never stand in for independent Model_P.

next_action: Implement only as preregistered research experiments with temporal/PIT isolation. No item in this audit may alter current bettor-facing eligibility without independent frozen evidence.
